column1: # The AutoHotkey v2.0.19 surface, read out of AutoHotkey64.exe.
# kind      command, function, variable or method
# class     the class a method belongs to, empty otherwise
# handler   the address of the handler, in the binary
# min       the fewest parameters, where the binary states it
# max       the most parameters, 255 for any number
# variant   the byte that picks the flavour of a shared handler
# The command entries keep their arity in a packing that was not
# decoded, so their arity columns are empty rather than wrong.
